iterate_all_bsuite_ids: iterate over all bsuite experiment IDs using the SWEEP tuple for hyperparameter sweeps
lookup_settings_by_id: look up environment constructor kwargs for a given bsuite_id using the SETTINGS mapping
filter_experiments_by_tag: filter experiments by tag using TAGS mapping like TAGS['memory'] or TAGS['basic']
get_testing_subset: get the representative subset of bsuite_ids for agent tests using the TESTING tuple
lookup_episodes_for_id: look up the number of episodes to run for a bsuite_id using the EPISODES mapping
